FAQ_Subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about UK Stay Hub
FAQ_Q1: How does booking on UK Stay Hub work?
FAQ_A1: Booking is simple! Just search for your desired location and dates, choose a property that fits your needs, and follow the easy booking steps. You'll receive instant confirmation.
FAQ_Q2: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQ_A2: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, and direct bank transfers for select properties.
FAQ_A3: Cancellation policies vary by property. You can check the specific cancellation policy on each property listing before booking. Many offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in.
FAQ_Q4: Is UK Stay Hub free for guests?
FAQ_A4: Yes, searching and browsing properties on UK Stay Hub is completely free for guests, and there is no service fee when you book (£0). The price you see includes all fees, so there are no surprises.
FAQ_Q5: How do I become a host?
FAQ_A5: Becoming a host is easy! Click on 'List your property' in the menu, create an account, and follow the steps to list your accommodation. Our team will verify it and it will be live!
FAQ_A6: Our support team is available every day from 08:00 to 18:00 (UK time). Email support@ukstayhub.co.uk or call +44 20 7946 0000. You can also find our contact details on the Contact page.

Review1_Text: I paid exactly what I saw — saved £19 vs. other platforms for the exact same dates. No extra fees, no surprises. This should be the standard everywhere.
Review2_Text: The photos matched reality 100%. We arrived and it looked exactly as expected. After years of disappointment on other platforms, this was genuinely refreshing.
Review3_Text: I called on Saturday evening with a booking question and a real person picked up within minutes. I never experienced that with other platforms. UK Stay Hub is the future.
Testimonial1_Text: Amazing accommodation in the heart of nature! The hosts were very kind and welcoming. The cottage was clean and well equipped. We'll definitely come back with the whole family.
Testimonial2_Text: A great experience from start to finish. Communication was fast and the accommodation matched the photos exactly. Highly recommended for anyone looking for peaceful relaxation.
Testimonial3_Text: A beautiful view and incredible calm. This place was exactly what we needed to escape the city. The beds were extremely comfortable.
Testimonial4_Text: Booking through UK Stay Hub was fast and hassle-free. All the information was clear, and a pleasant surprise of local products was waiting for us on arrival.
Hero_SavingsLabel: Save an average of £23 vs. other platforms
Savings_Subtitle: Final price comparison for the same accommodation (£89/night)
Savings_Disclaimer: * Example calculation. Actual savings depend on the selected accommodation.
changesSaved: Changes saved here take effect immediately across the platform.
VerifiedAccommodations: Explore verified stays offered directly by this owner.
FlexiblePricingDesc: Set different nightly rates per season and per length of stay. Leave the maximum empty for an open-ended range such as 7+ nights.
FlexiblePricingEmpty: No price periods yet. Add one to charge seasonal rates.
FlexiblePriceDatesRequired: both a start and an end date are required
FlexiblePriceEndBeforeStart: the end date is before the start date
FlexiblePriceTierRequired: add at least one night range with a price
FlexiblePriceTierInvalid: a night range has a maximum lower than its minimum
PayoutSettingsIntro: Your listings can take bookings once both steps are done: connect Stripe so we have somewhere to send your money, and add the billing details we need to invoice you for the platform fee.
PayoutEditBillingIntro: These appear on the monthly invoice UK Stay Hub issues you for the platform fee. Changes apply to invoices raised from now on.
PayoutsNotActiveListings: Online payments are not switched on for your listings yet. You can still add your billing details now — they carry over automatically.
PayoutsNotActiveNoListings: Once you publish a listing, your payouts will appear here. You can add your billing details now so there is nothing to do later.
PayoutStripeConnectedBody: Your account is connected. You can now receive payouts.
PayoutLoadErrorTitle: Could not load your account details
PayoutLoadErrorBody: Your billing and payout status cannot be shown right now. Nothing has been lost — anything you have already saved is still on file.
PayoutBillingNeededBody: We invoice you monthly for the platform fee taken from your payouts, and cannot release funds until we have the details that invoice requires.
PayoutAvailableEmpty: No funds available for immediate withdrawal.
PayoutAvailableHint: The stay has started and the hold has passed. Withdraw whenever you like — anything left here is released automatically by the daily run.
PayoutUpcomingHint: Released {hours} hours after check-in. Nothing to do — this happens on its own.
PayoutFailedTitle: Payouts that did not go through
PayoutFailedHint: Stripe refused these. Fix whatever it names below and try again, or leave them — the daily run retries on its own.
PayoutFailedUnknown: Stripe did not give a reason.
PayoutFailedRetryNote: We retry this automatically once a day.
PayoutAmountUnknownHint: We have no payout split recorded for this booking, so it cannot be withdrawn here. Please contact support.
PayoutConnectBody: Guests pay through UK Stay Hub and the money is sent straight to your own Stripe account — it never sits with us. You can add your billing details before or after this step.
PayoutBillingSavedNote: Your billing details are saved. Connecting Stripe is the only step left.
PayoutSessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
PayoutOwnProfileOnly: You can only connect a Stripe account for your own profile.
PayoutQueuedToast: Payout queued — it will be released automatically.
PayoutBillingRequiredToast: We need your billing details before releasing this payout.
BillingModalIntro: UK Stay Hub issues you a monthly invoice for the platform fee deducted from your payouts. We need these details before we can release your money — you only have to enter them once.
BillingModalFootnote: These appear on the invoice UK Stay Hub issues to you. They are not sent to guests.
BillingErrIcoFormat: A UK company number has 8 characters, e.g. 01234567 or SC123456
BillingErrIcDphFormat: A VAT number looks like GB123456789, or leave it empty
BillingErrZipFormat: Enter a valid UK postcode, e.g. SW1A 1AA
BillingSaveFailed: Could not save your billing details
BillingSaveIncomplete: Your billing details were not saved completely. Please try again.
BillingSaveError: Something went wrong while saving your billing details
HostInvoicesIntro: Monthly invoices for the platform fee already deducted from your payouts. Each one is also emailed to you when it is issued.
HostInvoicesEmpty: No invoices yet. The first one is issued at the start of the month after your first payout.
OnboardBillingBody: Stripe has verified you. We just need your invoicing details — we issue you a monthly invoice for the platform fee, and your listings cannot take bookings until we have them.
BillingModalNamePlaceholder: Only if you trade under a company
BillingIcoManual: Business-register lookup is unavailable. You can enter the details manually.
BillingIcoIsBranch: This is a branch. Invoice the parent company instead?
CustomPolicyTiersDesc: Up to three tiers. The last one must be 0 hours / 0% so a no-show never earns a refund.
CancellationPolicyNoteDesc: Shown alongside the refund tiers above. Descriptive only — the tiers decide the refund.
SelectDatesToSeeTotal: Select dates to see the total price
ExactAddressAfterBooking: The exact address will be provided after your booking is confirmed.
GoogleMapsKeyMissing: The map requires a Google Maps API key, which is not currently configured in this environment.
LocationMapAutoLoad: The map loads automatically when this section comes into view.
LocationMapLoading: Loading the map for this area…
LocationMapApproximate: This map shows the approximate area. The exact address is shared after your booking is confirmed.
LocationMapFailed: The map could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
DefaultListingDescription: Discover this verified accommodation on UK Stay Hub.
SimilarAccommodationsError: Similar accommodations couldn't be loaded right now.
CheckConnectionRetry: Please check your connection and try again.
ReviewInvalidLink: ❌ Invalid review link. Accommodation ID missing.
CancelToastNotOnline: This booking cannot be cancelled online. Please contact support.
CancelToastDone: Booking cancelled. No refund is due.
CancelToastRefund: Booking cancelled. Refund of {amount} is on its way.
CancelErr_already_paid_out: This booking was already paid out to the host and needs support to cancel.
CancelErr_no_payment_intent: There is no payment to refund.
CancelErr_refund_failed: The refund could not be processed. Please try again or contact support.
CancelErr_no_policy_snapshot: This booking predates automated cancellation. Please contact support.
